claim_scope: Read-only source search for a rounded, compensated, or auxiliary FP32 residual-shadow mechanism. This is not numerical, HLO, TPU, performance, or Gate-D evidence.

findings.finding: The current vLLM fused add RMSNorm contract adds in FP32, returns the sum rounded to the original activation dtype, and normalizes the unrounded transient FP32 sum. It contains no persistent FP32 shadow or auxiliary device consumer.
The fetched TPU Inference GLM PR ref contains GLM launch/smoke/model-registration material but no Python GLM residual-shadow kernel. No source-derived Gate-D successor was found.
The current TPU Inference main delta from the previously audited main changes only a generated support matrix, not executable GLM/RMS source.
